interpretation_notes: Location predicates here/there/home depend on the utterance context; no geographic referent is resolved.
Tense and full number agreement are not represented by this fragment.
Positive English modals use explicit content operators (possible, permitted, necessary, obligatory, future, conditional); their modal axioms and negative scope readings are not supplied.

Nominal similes compare a manner with a CN description. manner_like supplies no resemblance axioms, animal existence, or identification of the subject with the comparison noun. Selected goal frames and LINK location/path modifiers remain distinct; temporal and spatial inference is not supplied.

Polar do/does/did questions retain a labelled query content; no tense or full agreement semantics is supplied. Local reflexives bind to the clause subject, with speaker/addressee identities evaluated at each word. Yes affirms the previous complete query content; No negates it. These are content interpretations, not grounding or truth judgments.

because(main, reason) relates two locally closed clause contents. It is an opaque causal relation, with no causal inference or truth axioms. Postposed reasons use LINK; preposed finite reasons require a comma and a main clause. Because-of nominals, nonfinite reasons, and unrestricted attachment/scope are not supplied.

Finite clause relations preserve distinct causal, temporal, conditional, concessive and contrastive contributions as typed, opaque relations (main, subordinate). Conditional is not material implication; no tense/event calculus, temporal anchoring, counterfactual or concessive inference is supplied. Structural completion does not validate an ambiguous connective's interpretation.

Temporal adverbs retain distinct later/earlier/late/early and deictic operators. Their comparison/reference times and calendar anchoring are contextual; past/present tense inference and full temporal reasoning are not implemented.

clause_relations.because: The subordinate content gives a reason for the main content.
clause_relations.when_clause: The subordinate content supplies a temporal occasion for the main content.
clause_relations.whenever_clause: The subordinate content supplies repeated occasions; quantification over times is not resolved.
clause_relations.while_clause: Temporal overlap of the main and subordinate situations.
clause_relations.before_clause: The main situation precedes the subordinate situation.
clause_relations.after_clause: The main situation follows the subordinate situation.
clause_relations.since_time: The subordinate situation supplies a starting boundary for the main situation.
clause_relations.until_clause: The subordinate situation supplies an ending boundary for the main situation.
clause_relations.condition: The subordinate content conditions the main content; not automatically material implication.
clause_relations.unless_clause: The subordinate content supplies an exception condition; no automatic negation or biconditional.
clause_relations.concession: The main content holds despite an expectation associated with the subordinate content.
clause_relations.contrast: The main and subordinate contents are contrasted.
